_how_to_match: expected_doc is a case-insensitive substring of documents.title as ingest stores it: PDF = file name without extension, DOCX/MD upload = first # heading, repo doc = 'file.md (path)' or 'FILE.md' in the root. expected_page is set only for PDFs. expected_answer is a short reference for checking the generated text by hand or with an LLM judge. Out-of-corpus questions must abstain (and then hand off).

questions.question: What is the Definition of Done?
questions.expected_answer: CODEOWNER approval, CI green, acceptance criteria checked, tests, Hermes runbook updated if Hermes changed, docs updated, checked on staging.

questions.question: How long do juniors keep their buddy?
questions.expected_answer: Six months (other new engineers: three months).

questions.question: Can I write my standup update instead of saying it in the call?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. Async standup is allowed: post the three answers in the standup thread before 10:00.

questions.question: When do new engineers join the on-call rotation?
questions.expected_answer: Not in the first six months; then two shadow weeks before being on call alone.

questions.question: What is Hermes?
questions.expected_answer: The invoicing queue (Redis-backed BullMQ). Invoice emails, PDFs and dunning jobs go through it.

questions.question: What does Atlas do?
questions.expected_answer: Atlas is the API gateway: every external request enters through it; it checks the session and forwards signed identity headers.

questions.question: When does the invoice cron run and what does it do?
questions.expected_answer: Every day at 06:00; it issues due invoices and puts their PDF and email jobs on Hermes.

questions.question: When are payment reminders (dunning) sent?
questions.expected_answer: 3, 10 and 21 days after the due date, if the invoice is not paid.

questions.question: Why don't we send invoice emails directly inside the HTTP request?
questions.expected_answer: Slow mail provider made the cron overlap, crashes caused duplicate emails, support could not see failures; so all slow/external work goes through Hermes (ADR-007).

questions.question: Which Node.js version do I need for invoicing-service?
questions.expected_answer: Node 20 (20.11 or newer), not 21 or 22.

questions.question: How do I start the service on my laptop?
questions.expected_answer: The 12 steps in docs/setup.md: Node 20, clone, npm ci, .env, docker compose up, migrate, seed, npm run dev, worker, curl with dev token, tests, web page.

questions.question: I get Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432. How do I fix it?
questions.expected_answer: Postgres is not running or the port is taken: docker compose up -d, or stop the local Postgres / change the port.

questions.question: Locally every request returns 401 'Request did not come through Atlas'. What should I do?
questions.expected_answer: Send the dev token: Authorization: Bearer local-dev-only (must match ATLAS_DEV_TOKEN).

questions.question: Hermes jobs stay in waiting and never run. Why?
questions.expected_answer: The worker is not started or uses another queue name; run npm run worker and check HERMES_QUEUE.

questions.question: What does nit: mean in a code review comment?
questions.expected_answer: A small style or naming preference; the author decides, it is not required.

questions.question: A reviewer left a comment with no prefix. Do I have to change the code?
questions.expected_answer: A comment without a prefix is a question: answer it in the thread before changing code.

questions.question: What has to be done before I can merge my pull request?
questions.expected_answer: CODEOWNER approval, CI green, acceptance criteria checked, Hermes runbook updated if needed, all blocking comments resolved.

questions.question: How fast should reviewers answer my pull request?
questions.expected_answer: Within one working day; after that, mention the reviewer in #team-invoicing.

questions.question: How do I replay a failed Hermes job?
questions.expected_answer: npx tsx scripts/hermes-replay.ts --job <jobId> from a pod shell; safe because the job id is the idempotency key.

questions.question: What does the HermesQueueDepthHigh alert mean?
questions.expected_answer: More than 5,000 jobs waiting for 10 minutes; first check whether the worker is running in Beacon.

questions.question: When is the meeting-free time?
questions.expected_answer: Wednesday mornings until 13:00.

questions.question: Do I have to turn my camera on in meetings?
questions.expected_answer: No, cameras are optional in every meeting.

questions.question: What is the deadline for the security training?
questions.expected_answer: Within 30 days of the start date, then every year in January.

questions.question: I think I committed an API key by mistake. What do I do?
questions.expected_answer: Treat it as leaked: rotate it immediately and tell #security, even if the commit was deleted.

questions.question: How do I ask for a workplace adjustment?
questions.expected_answer: Talk to your manager or write to people@brightline.example; explain what is harder and what would help.

questions.question: What is the parental leave policy in Germany?
questions.why: No HR or leave documents in the corpus.

questions.question: Who approves DB migrations?
questions.why: Demo handoff to Ana. CODEOWNERS lists /db/ owners, but no document says who approves migrations.

questions.question: Which date format should the invoice CSV export use?
questions.why: #142 ambiguity: dates.ts has both formats and no document decides.

questions.question: How many days does the company have to answer my adjustment request?
questions.why: Planted gap: the Workplace Adjustments Policy has no response time.

questions.question: What is the salary range for a junior developer at Brightline?
questions.why: No compensation documents in the corpus.
